notes: The study's master PROC FORMAT catalog (68 value-label sets covering demographics, smoking, alcohol, reproductive history, and the thyroid-cancer outcome codings used by every other script in data_management/), reproduced verbatim including the source file's own Windows-codepage mojibake apostrophes/micro signs. The external `original` read and PROC CATALOG COPY to a permanent library were dropped (neither is meaningful in isolation); a small smoke-test DATA step + PROC PRINT was added exercising a plain value list, a numeric range, an OTHER= catch-all, and the special-missing-value (.D/.E/.M/.P/.Q) range against fabricated values.
